Description

Paint your city with plants! In this cosy guerilla gardening game, turn harmful areas into gardens that everyone can use. Use freeform planting to customise your city, and get to know the local residents and their stories.

History

Started as a solo indie project in 2025. Inspired by books such as "The Lie of the Land".

Features

  • Freeform planting
  • Pollinate your plants to make more seeds. Cross pollinate different plants together to discover new hybrids.
  • Discover different plants with different abilities. For example, not all plants can survive in polluted areas.
  • Different residents will also join your mission and start to help you.

Press Start
The ‘Press Start: Games Founding Grant’ supported 132 creative minds in the games sector from January 2025 to June 2026 in founding their own games studios in Germany. This resulted in 75 founded games studios. The grant has been organised and implemented by game – the German Games Industry Association in cooperation with the The Foundation for Digital Games Culture. The grant was funded by the Minister of State for Culture and the Media. games-stipendium.de.
